443:t_2:23.en:
$$レド$$
(Then, the world $$エイミー$$ and I were in...)

443:t_2:24.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「$$ティファ$$... Please use your power to call out to $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$.」

443:t_2:25.en:
$$ティファ$$
「But... during the $$多元戦争$$, $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$ chose of his own will to go to sleep...」

443:t_2:26.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Thank you, $$ティファ$$. You respect his will.」

443:t_2:27.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「But the time has come for both him and me to fulfill another mission.」

443:t_2:29.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「That very mission is also the history of how $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$ came to be.」

443:t_2:30.en:
$$ティファ$$
「...I understand. I can feel extraordinary resolve from you, $$ディアナ$$.」

443:t_2:31.en:
$$ティファ$$
「I'm sure $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$ feels the same way.」

443:t_2:32.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Are you going to be okay, $$ティファ$$?」

443:t_2:33.en:
$$ティファ$$
「I want to do what I can for this world too... together with $$ガロード$$.」

443:t_2:35.en:
$$ティファ$$
「$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$... Please answer my feelings.」

443:t_2:36.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Here and now, in the name of the mission entrusted to me by my forefathers, I demand the truth from you.」

443:t_2:40.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「...It's been a long time, $$ティファ$$.」

443:t_2:42.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「It's all right. I too had a feeling that this day would come someday.」

443:t_2:43.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「I know about your situation and the state of Earth as well. I fell asleep, but I did not cut myself off from information from the outside...」

443:t_2:46.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「I'll tell you about that in due time. First, there are some people I must greet.」

443:t_2:47.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「You mean them, don't you.」

443:t_2:49.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Could it be... you mean us?」

443:t_2:50.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Isn't it an honor that the one sleeping on the Moon knows of the likes of us?」

443:t_2:51.en:
$$レド$$
「...You said $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$, didn't you. Our world... the $$残されの海$$... was it a part of the world you were in?」

443:t_2:52.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「Exactly. I welcome you, guardians of the green sea and descendants of our kin who returned from the galaxy.」

443:t_2:53.en:
$$ロラン$$
「The $$ガルガンティア船団$$ are people from the same world as ours...!?」

443:t_2:54.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'd heard that the Earth where the $$人類銀河同盟$$ was born and the Fleet's Earth are the same, but you're saying that's the future of the $$ＵＣＷ$$ too!?」

443:t_2:55.en:
$$レド$$
「...It's true. In the ruins in the $$霧の海$$, I obtained data that backs it up.」

443:t_2:56.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Hey, you! Why didn't you tell us that!?」

443:t_2:58.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Stop it, $$ピニオン$$. $$レド$$ must have had his reasons.」

443:t_2:60.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「I can understand how he feels. For the humans who abandoned Earth and sought a new land in the galaxy, Earth was also the place that gave birth to an existence they could never accept.」

443:t_2:61.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Will you explain it to us in order, $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$?」

443:t_2:63.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「As you already know, the era called the $$黒歴史$$ originates from $$シャア・アズナブル$$'s $$アクシズ$$ drop.」

443:t_2:65.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(A future where Colonel $$シャア$$ and Captain $$アムロ$$ fight each other...)

443:t_2:66.en:
$$シン$$
(Even if only on the surface, the $$時獄戦役$$ was heading down that road, huh...)

443:t_2:67.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「Because of that, Earth entered a nuclear winter. And yet, humanity still did not stop waging war.」

443:t_2:68.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「And not only wars among humans. Humanity kept fighting all manner of external enemies, aliens included.」

443:t_2:69.en:
$$ロラン$$
「And at the very end of it, human civilization was buried by the $$月光蝶$$, right?」

443:t_2:70.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「That's right. But before it came to that, humanity tried to restore Earth's environment by various means.」

443:t_2:71.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「One of them was removing ocean pollution with nanomachines... commonly known as the Verdurous Star Worm Project.」

443:t_2:72.en:
$$レド$$
「So those are the nanomachines of the $$残されの海$$...」

443:t_2:73.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「Correct. And one of the ships built to improve and survey the ocean environment is the $$ガルガンティア$$.」

443:t_2:74.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「Their mission was to live on the ocean and restore the environment of the sea, the mother of life.」

443:t_2:75.en:
$$エイミー$$
「So our ancestors were there...」

443:t_2:76.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「I see... So that's what the $$残されの海$$ meant.」

443:t_2:77.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But in the end, the $$月光蝶$$ caused human civilization to decline...」

443:t_2:78.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「Perhaps it would be more accurate to say they had no other choice.」

443:t_2:79.en:
$$シャア$$
(That was a loaded way to put it...)

443:t_2:80.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「But before the $$月光蝶$$ was activated, there was a group that abandoned the polluted Earth and sought a new land in the galaxy.」

443:t_2:81.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「They called themselves $$イボルバー$$s and tried to evolve artificially in order to adapt to the environment.」

443:t_2:83.en:
$$レド$$
「...That's what the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ really are.」

443:t_2:85.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「You mean the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ are what humans have become in the end...!?」

443:t_2:86.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Then... the $$クジライカ$$ were originally human too...」

443:t_2:87.en:
$$レド$$
「Yes. They adapted to Earth's sea, so their combat strength was low too, but...」

443:t_2:88.en:
$$レド$$
「The $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ fighting the $$人類銀河同盟$$ kept evolving to suit the harsh environment of space and gained tremendous vitality.」

443:t_2:89.en:
$$レド$$
「But at the same time, holding that the essential meaning of a living thing lies in living, they cast off intellect and civilization...」

443:t_2:90.en:
$$ルカ$$
「So that's... what those $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ are...」

443:t_2:91.en:
$$オズマ$$
「But once they've gone that far, you can't call them human anymore...」

443:t_2:92.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$ said the same thing. Presumably the leadership of the $$人類銀河同盟$$ is fighting the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ on the same judgment.」

443:t_2:93.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$レド$$, you ended up carrying a secret that big all by yourself in the $$霧の海$$, didn't you...」

443:t_2:94.en:
$$レド$$
「I... killed the $$クジライカ$$... who were originally my kin...」

443:t_2:95.en:
$$レド$$
「No... even before that, I had killed countless $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$...」

443:t_2:97.en:
$n
「That's right. Not that I'm trying to comfort you, but both sides fought with their survival on the line. Nobody's to blame.」

443:t_2:100.en:
$$テッサ$$
「And by learning that fact, you were able to take a fresh look at your own way of life, not as a soldier.」

443:t_2:101.en:
$$レド$$
「...When everything I had believed in collapsed from the foundation, I think that was the first time I became able to think for myself.」

443:t_2:103.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If you've become able to confirm your own will, then think about what comes next.」

443:t_2:104.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Think now about what to do the next time you run into the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$.」
